query:
-- Molécules avec même CAS number (doublons certains)
SELECT cas_number, COUNT(*) as nb, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ',') as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') as noms
FROM molecules
WHERE cas_number IS NOT NULL AND cas_number != ''
GROUP BY cas_number
HAVING nb > 1
ORDER BY nb DESC
LIMIT 20;
